Get Latest Application State

This API endpoint retrieves the latest application state for a specific application.

Args:
    application_id (str): The ID of the application to retrieve the latest state for.
    application_type (str): The type of the application to retrieve the latest state for.

Returns:
    JSONResponse: A JSON object containing the latest application state if found, else None.
